summary_zh: 本页为绘本标题页，展示成语“李代桃僵”，配图是一名持刀士兵和一名持杖老者，暗示故事即将展开。

page_text_ocr_zh: 春秋时期，晋景公最信任的大臣是司寇屠岸贾。屠岸贾与晋国世族赵家有旧仇。赵家为晋国立过大功，屠岸贾却诬陷他们杀害晋灵公，发兵包围了赵家。赵家上下三百多口人，屠岸贾让士兵对着名册一个一个点，不论主人还是仆人，老人还是孩子，一个都不能少，统统要伏法。
page_text_en: In the Spring and Autumn period, the most trusted minister of Duke Jing of Jin was Si Kou Tu An Jia. Tu An Jia had an old grudge against the Zhao family, a noble clan of Jin. Although the Zhao family had rendered great service to Jin, Tu An Jia falsely accused them of murdering Duke Ling of Jin, and sent troops to besiege the Zhao family. With over three hundred people in the Zhao household, Tu An Jia ordered soldiers to check the roster one by one, regardless of whether they were masters or servants, elders or children—none could be spared, all were to be executed.
summary_zh: 本页讲述了春秋时期，晋国大臣屠岸贾因私仇诬陷赵家谋反，率兵包围赵家，并下令将赵家三百多口人无论老少一律处死。

page_text_ocr_zh:
三天两夜，惨叫不绝，赵府血流成河。第三天晚上，士兵一把火点燃了赵府，谁也不敢去扑救。
大火烧红了半边天，一夜之后，赵府就成了一片废墟。除了嫁到赵家的晋国公主，悄悄逃回了王宫，
赵家一个活着的人也没有了。
page_text_en:
For three days and two nights, screams echoed endlessly, and blood flowed like a river in the Zhao mansion. On the third night, soldiers set fire to the Zhao residence, and no one dared to put it out.
The fire turned half the sky red. After one night, the Zhao mansion became a ruin. Except for the Jin princess who had married into the Zhao family, who secretly fled back to the palace,
there was not a single living person left in the Zhao family.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了赵府被屠岸贾派兵纵火焚烧的惨状，大火持续三天两夜，赵家三百多口人全部遇难，仅剩嫁入赵家的晋国公主逃回王宫幸免于难。

page_text_ocr_zh: 公主是晋景公的亲姑妈，当时已经怀孕九个多月了。她逃进王宫后，藏在晋景公的宫殿里，一步也不敢离开。公主的丈夫名叫赵朔，也在抄家时被害了。
page_text_en: The princess was the niece of Duke Jing of Jin, and at the time, she was more than nine months pregnant. After fleeing into the royal palace, she hid in Duke Jing's palace and dared not leave even a single step. Her husband, named Zhao Shuo, was also killed during the purge.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了赵家被抄后，嫁入赵家的晋国公主因怀孕九个多月而逃入王宫，藏身于晋景公宫殿中，其丈夫赵朔在抄家时遇害。

page_text_ocr_zh:
赵朔的门客公孙杵臼，找到了
赵朔的好朋友程婴，瞪着眼问
他：“赵先君以前对你那么好，
你为什么不为他殉难？”程婴伤心
地说：“我现在还不能死。听说
公主已经怀孕了，如果平安生
下来，我要抚养孩子长大。”
page_text_en:
Zhaoshuo's guest, Gongsun Chujiu, found
Zhaoshuo's good friend Cheng Ying, and glared at him, asking:
"The late Lord Zhao treated you so well before,
why didn't you die for him?" Cheng Ying said sadly:
"I cannot die yet. I've heard the princess is pregnant.
If she gives birth safely, I will raise the child."
summary_zh: 赵朔的门客公孙杵臼质问好友程婴为何不为赵先君殉难，程婴表示自己不能死，因为听说公主已怀孕，他要抚养孩子长大。

page_text_ocr_zh:
哇！
哇！
哇！
孩子？
不是吗？
哇！
"哇——哇——哇——"没过几天，
王宫里响起了婴儿的啼哭声，公
主真的生下了一个男孩，赵氏又
有了一个新的生命。
屠岸贾听说后，就带着士兵来搜
宫，要剿灭赵氏最后的血脉。公

page_text_en:
Wa!
Wa!
Wa!
Child?
Not really?
Wa!
"Wa—wa—wa—" A few days later,
the palace echoed with the cries of a newborn. The princess had given birth to a boy, and the Zhao family had a new life.
When Tu'an Jia heard this, he brought soldiers to search the palace, determined to exterminate the last bloodline of the Zhao family. The princess, holding the child, didn't know where to hide him. "Child, where is the safest place for you to hide?"
summary_zh: 公主在王宫中生下赵氏遗腹子，屠岸贾闻讯率兵搜宫欲斩草除根，公主抱着婴儿不知何处藏身，内心焦急。

page_text_ocr_zh: 士兵撞开宫门冲了进来。箱子里，没有。床下面，没有。帐幔后，没有。公主稳坐在案边，不敢轻易挪动一寸。她心里暗暗在祈求：“孩子，你不能哭，千万不能哭呀！”
page_text_en: Soldiers crashed through the palace door and rushed in. In the box, nothing. Under the bed, nothing. Behind the curtain, nothing. The princess sat steadily by the table, daring not to move even an inch. In her heart, she silently prayed: "Child, you must not cry, you absolutely must not cry!"
summary_zh: 屠岸贾派兵搜查王宫，寻找赵氏遗腹子。公主藏身于案边，内心焦急，祈求婴儿不要哭出声，以免暴露行踪。

page_text_ocr_zh: 搜遍整座宫殿，都没有找到婴儿，屠岸贾只好带着士兵气冲冲地走了。公主把婴儿藏在哪里了呢？等到外面没有声音后，公主轻轻掀开了裙摆。裙摆下面，一个胖嘟嘟的婴儿，闭着眼睛睡得正香呢！
page_text_en: They searched the entire palace but couldn't find the baby. Tu Anjia could only leave with his soldiers, angrily storming off. Where had the princess hidden the baby? After the noise outside faded, the princess gently lifted her skirt. Beneath it, a plump baby slept soundly with eyes closed!
summary_zh: 屠岸贾搜遍宫殿未找到赵氏遗腹子，只得带兵离开。公主在确认安全后，掀开裙摆，发现婴儿正安然熟睡。

page_text_ocr_zh: 屠岸贾以为婴儿已经被送出了宫，就张贴告示，悬赏捉拿。程婴发愁地说："今天没有搜到，明天还会再去搜。这样下去，孩子总有一天会被找出来的呀！"怎样才能让屠岸贾不再搜捕呢？
page_text_en: Tu'an Jia thought the baby had already been taken out of the palace, so he posted a notice offering a reward for its capture. Cheng Ying worriedly said, "Today we didn't find him, but tomorrow they will search again. If we keep going like this, the child will surely be found one day!" How can we make Tu'an Jia stop searching?
summary_zh: 屠岸贾张贴告示悬赏捉拿赵氏遗腹子，程婴担忧孩子终将被发现，思考如何阻止屠岸贾继续搜捕。

page_text_ocr_zh: 公孙杵臼和程婴想出了一个办法。他们从别处抱来一个小婴儿，给他包上绣着赵氏族徽的小花被。一切准备好了，公孙杵臼问程婴："保护赵氏遗孤和以死报恩相比，哪个更难呢？"
page_text_en: Gongsun Chujiu and Cheng Ying came up with a plan. They brought a baby from elsewhere and wrapped him in a small floral blanket embroidered with the Zhao family emblem. Everything was ready, and Gongsun Chujiu asked Cheng Ying: "Compared to protecting the orphan of the Zhao family, which is harder—dying to repay a debt of gratitude?"
summary_zh: 公孙杵臼和程婴商议对策，决定用一个婴儿冒充赵氏遗孤，并询问程婴保护遗孤与以死报恩哪个更难。

page_text_ocr_zh: 程婴回答道：‘当然是保护孩子更难，死多么容易呀！’公孙杵臼说：‘那么，难的事情交给你，容易的事情就让我来做吧！’他小心地抱起包在被子里的孩子，躲过搜查的士兵，跑进了深山里。
page_text_en: Cheng Ying replied, 'Of course, protecting the child is harder; death is so easy!' Gongsun Chujiu said, 'Then, the difficult task is yours, and the easy one, I'll take care of!' He carefully picked up the child wrapped in a blanket, evaded the searching soldiers, and ran into the deep mountains.
summary_zh: 程婴与公孙杵臼商议后，决定由程婴保护赵氏遗孤，公孙杵臼则承担更危险的任务。公孙杵臼抱起婴儿，躲过搜查士兵，逃入深山。

page_text_ocr_zh: 他前脚刚走，程婴后脚就向屠岸贾告了密：‘司寇大人，只要给我一千两黄金，我就告诉您赵氏孤儿藏在哪里！’屠岸贾听了很高兴，立刻拿出一千两黄金给程婴。然后，他按程婴的指引调动军队，抓住了公孙杵臼和那个孩子。
page_text_en: As soon as he left, Cheng Ying immediately went to report to Tu Anjia: 'Lord, if you give me a thousand taels of gold, I will tell you where the orphan of the Zhao family is hidden!' Tu Anjia was very pleased and immediately handed over a thousand taels of gold to Cheng Ying. Then, following Cheng Ying's lead, he mobilized his troops and captured Gongsun Chujiu and the child.
summary_zh: 程婴向屠岸贾告密，以一千两黄金为代价，指认赵氏孤儿的藏身之处，屠岸贾据此率兵抓捕了公孙杵臼和婴儿。

page_text_ocr_zh: 公孙杵臼一见程婴，马上大骂起来：“你这个卑鄙小人，为什么要出卖我们！”他把孩子抱在怀中大声哭喊着，“天哪！天哪！孩子有什么罪啊，请你们饶了他，要抓就抓我一个人！”可是，屠岸贾怎么肯答应呢？士兵们一拥而上，把公孙杵臼和孩子都抓走了。
page_text_en: Gongsun Chujiu, upon seeing Cheng Ying, immediately shouted angrily, “You despicable man, why would you betray us!” He held the child in his arms and cried out loudly, “Heaven! Heaven! What crime has this child committed? Please spare him—arrest me instead!” But how could Tu Anjia possibly agree? The soldiers rushed forward and seized both Gongsun Chujiu and the child.
summary_zh: 公孙杵臼发现程婴告密后愤怒斥责，抱着婴儿恳求屠岸贾饶恕，但士兵们强行将他和孩子抓走。

page_text_ocr_zh: 屠岸贾以为他抓到的孩子就是赵氏孤儿。从此以后，他不再派人四处搜捕了。程婴便扮成大夫，提着药箱，进宫去给公主看病。公主抱出孩子，流着泪对程婴说：‘这孩子是赵家最后的血脉了，求您带他出去，抚养他平安长大。’程婴把孩子放进药箱，悄悄带出了王宫。
page_text_en: Tu'an Jia thought the child he had captured was the orphan of the Zhao family. From then on, he no longer sent men to search everywhere. Cheng Ying disguised himself as a doctor, carrying a medicine box, and entered the palace to treat the princess. The princess took out the child and, weeping, said to Cheng Ying: 'This child is the last bloodline of the Zhao family. I beg you to take him away and raise him to grow up safely.' Cheng Ying placed the child into the medicine box and secretly carried him out of the palace.
summary_zh: 程婴扮作大夫进宫，公主将赵氏遗孤托付给他，程婴将婴儿藏入药箱，成功带出王宫。

page_text_ocr_zh: 程婴带着孩子躲在深山里，给他起名叫赵武，每天教他学文练武。十五年后，赵氏孤儿赵武长大了。他知道了自已的身世，在晋悼公和大臣们的帮助下，终于成功复仇。
page_text_en: Cheng Ying took the child and hid in the deep mountains, naming him Zhao Wu, and taught him literature and martial arts every day. Fifteen years later, the orphan Zhao Wu grew up. He learned about his true identity, and with the help of Duke Jin Diao and the ministers, he finally succeeded in taking revenge.
summary_zh: 程婴将赵氏孤儿藏于深山，抚养其长大，并教他文武。十五年后，赵武得知身世，在晋悼公和大臣帮助下成功复仇。

page_text_ocr_zh:
公孙杵臼抱着假孤儿逃进深山里，程婴引着屠岸贾抓住了他们。这样，真正的赵氏孤儿就安全了。
李代桃僵，原意是指李树代替桃树被虫蛀咬。在这个故事里，程婴和公孙杵臼正是用这个计策，借假孤儿，救下了真正的赵氏孤儿。
page_text_en:
Gongsun Chujiu, holding the fake orphan, fled into the mountains, while Cheng Ying led Tu Anjia to capture them. In this way, the real Zhao orphan was kept safe.
Li Dai Tao Jiang originally means that a plum tree takes the place of a peach tree to be eaten by insects. In this story, Cheng Ying and Gongsun Chujiu used this strategy, sacrificing the fake orphan to save the real Zhao orphan.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了公孙杵臼抱着假孤儿逃入深山，程婴引屠岸贾将其抓获，从而保护了真正的赵氏孤儿。文字解释了‘李代桃僵’的典故及其在故事中的应用。
